Index van statische en dynamische parkeerinformatie van Nederlandse gemeenten en private partijen. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the category Parkeren. Its tags are index, statisch, dynamisch, parkeren. The table has 7 columns. The portal shows 2018-12-31 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-rdw-nl-portal.
